AED 101S.name: Introduction to Art Education
AED 101S.description: First-year seminar introducing the field of art education, including a field experience component.

AED 211W.name: Interpreting Art Experience: Social-cultural Perspectives
AED 211W.description: Writing-intensive course interpreting art experience through social-cultural perspectives.

AED 225.name: Diversity, Pedagogy, and Visual Culture
AED 225.description: Examines diversity, pedagogy, and visual culture in art education.

AED 322.name: Media Arts Pedagogies, Transcultural Dialogues, & Bioethics
AED 322.description: Media arts pedagogies and transcultural dialogues in art education. Bulletin requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

AED 401.name: Curricula, Pedagogy, and Assessment in Art Education
AED 401.description: Curricula, pedagogy, and assessment methods in art education. Bulletin requires AED_BS major standing or permission of instructor, which the planner schema does not model directly.

AED 489.name: Advanced Practicum
AED 489.description: Advanced field-based practicum in art education. Bulletin also requires AED 490 as an enforced concurrent -- the bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan never schedules AED 490 anywhere, a real gap; added AED 490 as an explicit companion item in the same term as AED 489.

AED 490.name: Capstone Course in Art Education
AED 490.description: Capstone course in art education. Bulletin requires admission to the Teacher Preparation Program, which the planner schema does not model directly.

AED 495A.name: Art Education Student Teaching Practicum
AED 495A.description: Student teaching practicum, first placement (PK-4/elementary track). Bulletin also lists this as a mutual corequisite of AED 495B -- modeled one-directional (AED 495A requires AED 495B concurrently, not vice versa) since the engine's same-term scheduling can't resolve a mutual two-way concurrent requirement; both are scheduled in the same semester regardless.

AED 495B.name: Art Education Student Teaching Practicum
AED 495B.description: Student teaching practicum, second placement (PK-4/elementary track). See AED 495A's note on why pairwise concurrency isn't modeled both directions.

AED 495C.name: Art Education Student Teaching Practicum
AED 495C.description: Student teaching practicum, first placement (secondary track). Bulletin also lists this as a mutual corequisite of AED 495D -- modeled one-directional, same reasoning as AED 495A/495B.

AED 495D.name: Art Education Student Teaching Practicum
AED 495D.description: Student teaching practicum, second placement (secondary track). See AED 495C's note on why pairwise concurrency isn't modeled both directions.
